note: props[] is authoritative (from the TS AST). `values` lists a union prop members verbatim.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled inline alert. Renders a `<div>` with a severity-appropriate live-region role; an optional `icon`, `title`, and — when `onClose` is provided — an accessible dismiss button. All behavior is delegated via props.

props.name: aria-atomic
props.doc: Optional explicit `aria-atomic`, forwarded to the root element (announce the whole region).

props.name: aria-live
props.doc: Optional explicit live-region politeness, forwarded to the root element. The `role` (alert vs status) already carries an *implicit* live setting; a composer that treats this element as the live region (e.g. `<Toast>`) can set it *explicitly* for belt-and-suspenders AT support. When omitted, the role's implicit politeness applies — today's behavior is unchanged.

props.name: closeLabel
props.doc: Accessible label for the dismiss control — localized by the caller (default `Cerrar`).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Optional leading icon element, tinted to the variant's border color.

props.name: onClose
props.doc: When provided, renders an accessible dismiss (`×`) control and calls this on activation.

props.name: title
props.doc: Optional bold title above the body.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The semantic severity. Defaults to `info`.

components.name: AnnouncementBar
components.summary: A stateless announcement bar: one line of chrome text.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled identity chip. With `src` it renders an ``; without, it shows the derived initials (or `?` when `name` is empty). Purely presentational — the caller supplies identity data; this imports NO domain entity type.

props.name: name
props.doc: Display name — drives the initials fallback (first two words) and the hover `title`/`alt`.

props.name: shape
props.doc: Outline shape. Defaults to `circle`.

props.name: size
props.doc: Pixel diameter/side. Defaults to 36. The initials font scales to 40% of this.

props.name: src
props.doc: Image URL. When present it renders as the avatar; otherwise initials are derived from `name`.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled status chip. Renders a `<span>`; when `dot` is set it prepends a small `aria-hidden` accent dot (decorative — the text carries the meaning). All styling flows from the `tone` → brand-key mapping.

props.name: dot
props.doc: When `true`, renders a small leading dot in the tone's accent color.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The semantic status. Defaults to `neutral`.

components.name: Banner
components.summary: A stateless, PURE-SERVER promotional banner block. Its `` is a small `` CLIENT ISLAND (the one stateful element — a broken-URL fallback), so this section shell ships no hydration JS (FCA island-the-state). Renders a headline + body + up to two CTA links, either centered over a (tinted) background image or beside an image column in a split layout. Every visible piece is optional — an all-absent section still renders an inert shell rather than throwing (the "degrade, never crash" law). An `animation` media banner falls through to the image/placeholder path.

props.name: text
props.doc: Body copy. MUST be pre-sanitized by the caller — it renders via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` (legacy parity: the oracle renders `text` through `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`), so a merchant `<strong>`/`<em>` split survives. Mirrors `BannerProps.heading`'s seam.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.doc: Per-field background color override (resolved CSS color). Unset = the layout default.

props.name: backgroundColorHex
props.doc: The per-field `backgroundColor` RESOLVED to a concrete `#rrggbb` by the caller (`NexusBannerAdapter`), used ONLY for the AUTO text-contrast decision — the LIVE fill still uses `BannerProps.backgroundColor` (a CSS var). Lets contrast work for swatch picks (palette tokens like `white`/`accent`), not only literal hexes. Unset ⇒ contrast falls back to `backgroundColor` (a literal hex) or the layout heuristic.

props.name: containerWidth
props.doc: Centered-layout content max-width. Defaults to `7xl`.

props.name: contentAlignment
props.doc: Content-block position. Defaults to `auto` (layout default).

props.name: contentSpacing
props.doc: Content-stack gap. Defaults to `medium`.

props.name: cta
props.doc: Primary call-to-action (accent-filled button). Its `label`/`href` MUST be pre-sanitized.

props.name: ctaBackgroundColor
props.doc: Per-field CTA background color override (resolved CSS color). Unset = the accent token.

props.name: ctaBackgroundColorHex
props.doc: The per-field `ctaBackgroundColor` RESOLVED to a concrete `#rrggbb` by the caller, used ONLY to derive the primary-CTA LABEL color via contrast when no explicit `ctaTextColor` is set (legacy parity — the oracle contrasts the CTA label against its button fill). The live button fill still uses `BannerProps.ctaBackgroundColor`.

props.name: ctaTextColor
props.doc: Per-field CTA text color override (resolved CSS color). Unset = the bg token.

props.name: heading
props.doc: Optional distinct headline. MUST be pre-sanitized by the caller — it renders via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` so a merchant-authored `<strong>`/`<em>` split (the legacy heading grammar) survives instead of being flattened. Mirrors `ImageWithText`'s `heading` seam.

props.name: headingColor
props.doc: Per-field heading color override (resolved CSS color). Unset = the derived text color.

props.name: height
props.doc: Height preset. Defaults to `medium`.

props.name: image
props.doc: Optional background/column image URL. MUST be pre-sanitized (`sanitizeHref`) by the caller.

props.name: imageAlt
props.doc: Accessible name for the image; when absent the image is decorative (`aria-hidden`).

props.name: imagePosition
props.doc: Image focal point (`object-position`). Defaults to centered (50/50).

props.name: layout
props.doc: Layout variant. Defaults to `centered`.

props.name: overlayColor
props.doc: Overlay tint (centered layout only). Defaults to `black`.

props.name: overlayOpacity
props.doc: Overlay darkness over a background image, 0–100 (centered layout only). Defaults to 40.

props.name: secondaryCta
props.doc: Optional secondary call-to-action (outlined button). Its `label`/`href` MUST be pre-sanitized.

props.name: sectionSpacing
props.doc: Outer block margin rhythm. Defaults to `none`.

props.name: textAlignment
props.doc: Text alignment within the block. Unset ⇒ follows the (effective) content alignment.

props.name: textColor
props.doc: Per-field body color override (resolved CSS color). Unset = the derived text color.

props.name: textColorMode
props.doc: Text-color derivation mode. Defaults to `auto` (derive from overlay/layout).

props.name: textSize
props.doc: Body size preset. Defaults to `m`.

props.name: titleSize
props.doc: Heading size preset. Defaults to `m`.

props.name: verticalPosition
props.doc: Vertical anchoring (centered layout only). Defaults to `center`.

components.name: Button
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled button. Renders a native `<button>` so it is keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible by default (role `button`). All behavior is delegated via `onClick`. Passing `disabled` makes it genuinely inert (not focusable, not activatable) — see `ButtonProps`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: When `true`, the button is genuinely inert: the native `disabled` attribute removes it from the tab order and blocks activation (click/Enter), `aria-disabled` exposes the state to AT, and the cursor becomes `not-allowed`. Backward-compatible — `undefined` is today's enabled behavior.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled checkbox. The visible box is painted over a visually-hidden native `<input type="checkbox">`, so it is keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible and associated to its `label` by id. The checked state is controlled — `checked` in, `onCheckedChange(next)` out.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Controlled checked state — the caller owns it; this component holds no state.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.doc: Called with the next boolean on toggle. Behavior is fully delegated.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: When `true`, the native `disabled` attr removes it from the tab order and blocks toggling.

props.name: id
props.doc: Explicit element id. Falls back to a slug of `label` so the `<label htmlFor>` stays wired.

props.name: indeterminate
props.doc: Mixed/partial visual register (the dash). Paints as filled + exposes `aria-checked="mixed"`. Note: toggling a mixed box fires `onCheckedChange` with the underlying native boolean (never `"mixed"`) — the caller owns the mixed → checked transition.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label text, associated to the box by id. Recommended for an accessible name.

components.name: Collage
components.summary: A stateless collage block: an optional heading above a tokenized grid of tiles. Pure — owns no state. An empty `blocks` array renders an empty grid rather than throwing (the "degrade, never crash" law).

props.name: blocks
props.doc: The tiles to render. An empty array renders an empty, inert grid (never throws).

props.name: columns
props.doc: Desktop column count; clamped to at least 1. Defaults to 3.

props.name: heading
props.doc: Optional section heading rendered above the tile grid.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled table shell. Generic over the row type `T`; each column projects a cell via `render` (defaulting to the row's `key` field). Server-safe — it renders on the server for a read-only table and, when an `onSort` handler is supplied by a client parent, wires sortable headers as buttons.

props.name: rowKey
props.doc: Stable per-row key (never the array index).

props.name: caption
props.doc: Optional visually-hidden `<caption>` for the table's accessible name.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Rendered (spanning every column) when `rows` is empty — compose a Nexus `<EmptyState>`.

props.name: onSort
props.doc: Sort handler. Its presence turns `sortable` headers into buttons.

props.name: sort
props.type: { readonly key: string; readonly direction: SortDirection }
props.doc: The currently sorted column + direction — drives `aria-sort` and the indicator.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal / drawer surface. Portals to `document.body`, traps focus while open, closes on `Escape` or a backdrop click, and restores focus on close. Purely presentational — the caller owns `open` and every action; it holds only its own enter transition + the focus-trap machinery.

props.name: children
props.doc: The dialog body (a form, a confirmation message, …).

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Invoked by the backdrop click, the `Escape` key, and the built-in close control.

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether the dialog is mounted + visible. When `false`, renders `null` (nothing in the DOM).

props.name: title
props.doc: The accessible title — becomes the heading and the `aria-labelledby` target.

props.name: closeLabel
props.doc: Accessible label for the built-in close control — localized by the caller (default `Cerrar`).

props.name: footer
props.doc: Optional footer region for actions (e.g. Cancel / Save), pinned below the body.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `modal` (centered card, default) or `drawer` (right side sheet).

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled empty placeholder. Announces itself via `role="status"`; the icon is decorative and the `action` slot is whatever the caller renders.

props.name: title
props.doc: The primary line — what is empty / what to do. Carries the accessible meaning.

props.name: action
props.doc: Optional call-to-action slot (a rendered node — keeps this component server-safe).

props.name: body
props.doc: Optional secondary explanatory line.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Optional decorative glyph above the title (e.g. an `<Icon>`). Rendered `aria-hidden`.

components.name: FallbackImage
components.summary: An `` that degrades to `fallback` on a load error (broken-URL fallback).

props.name: alt
props.doc: Accessible name; pass `''` + `ariaHidden` for a decorative image.

props.name: src
props.doc: The image URL.

props.name: ariaHidden
props.doc: Mark the image decorative (`aria-hidden`) when it carries no accessible name.

props.name: fallback
props.doc: Rendered INSTEAD of the `` when `src` fails to load. Default: nothing (the caller's own placeholder/background shows through).

props.name: style
props.doc: Inline styles applied to the ``.

components.name: Hero
components.summary: A stateless hero block. The CTA renders only when a label is supplied.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: A stateless SVG frame. When `label` is set the glyph is meaningful (`role="img"`, `aria-label`); otherwise it is decorative (`aria-hidden`). Draws in `currentColor`. The caller supplies the `viewBox` + inner `path` markup — this component imports NO icon registry and NO domain type.

props.name: path
props.doc: The glyph's inner SVG markup (`<path .../>`, `<g>…`, …) as a raw string. Rendered verbatim into the `<svg>`; the caller owns this content and MUST supply trusted, static markup (it is injected via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, the only faithful way to render opaque vector-path strings).

props.name: viewBox
props.doc: The SVG `viewBox` for the supplied glyph (e.g. `"0 0 24 24"`).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name. When provided, the glyph is exposed to AT as `role="img"` with this `aria-label`; when omitted, the glyph is decorative and marked `aria-hidden`.

props.name: size
props.doc: Pixel width/height (square). Defaults to 24.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled icon-only button. Renders a native `<button>` so it is keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible by default, named by the required `label` (`aria-label`). All behavior is delegated via `onClick`. Passing `disabled` makes it genuinely inert — see `IconButtonProps`.

props.name: children
props.doc: The glyph to render — typically an `<Icon>` element.

props.name: label
props.doc: REQUIRED accessible name. An icon-only button carries no text, so this becomes its `aria-label` — localized by the caller. Without it the control is invisible to AT.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: When `true`, the button is genuinely inert: the native `disabled` attribute removes it from the tab order and blocks activation, `aria-disabled` exposes the state to AT, and the cursor becomes `not-allowed`. Backward-compatible — `undefined` is today's enabled behavior.

components.name: ImageWithText
components.summary: A stateless, PURE-SERVER image-with-text block; its `` is a small `` CLIENT ISLAND (broken-URL fallback), so the shell ships no hydration JS (FCA island-the-state). The figure is ALWAYS present (an `` when `image` is set, a token-styled placeholder otherwise); the CTA renders only when a label is supplied. Every visible piece is optional — an all-absent section still renders an inert shell rather than throwing (the "degrade, never crash" law).

props.name: backgroundColor
props.doc: Per-section background color override (resolved CSS color). Unset = the token/transparent default.

props.name: columnGapPx
props.doc: Gap between the image and text columns, in px. Defaults to the token `calc(var(--space) * 2)`.

props.name: contentAlignment
props.doc: How the text-column content aligns. Defaults to `start`.

props.name: ctaBackgroundColor
props.doc: Per-section CTA background color override (resolved CSS color).

props.name: ctaHref
props.doc: A destination the CTA navigates to. When supplied (and non-empty), the CTA renders as a real `<a href>` (legacy parity: the CTA is a `<Link>`). When absent, the CTA falls back to the token `<Button>` driven by `ImageWithTextProps.onCta`. MUST be pre-sanitized by the caller (the adapter routes it through `sanitizeHref`).

props.name: ctaTextColor
props.doc: Per-section CTA text color override (resolved CSS color).

props.name: focalPoint
props.doc: Image focal point (`object-position`); defaults to centered (50/50).

props.name: heading
props.doc: The heading markup. MUST be pre-sanitized by the caller before reaching this prop — it renders via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` so a merchant-authored `<strong>`/`<em>` split (the legacy heading grammar) survives instead of being flattened to plain text. This mirrors the codebase's established sanitize-at-the-seam pattern (`sanitize-merchant-html.ts`'s `sanitizeMerchantHtml`, and the vendored `l2-legacy-sections` modules' own `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: … }}` usages) — this component trusts its caller the same way those do; it performs no sanitization of its own.

props.name: headingColor
props.doc: Per-section heading color override (resolved CSS color).

props.name: imageHeightPx
props.doc: A fixed image-column pixel height. The real legacy oracle sizes this figure by a FIXED PIXEL HEIGHT (keyed by the section's `image_height` preset), not a fixed aspect-ratio — `object-fit: cover` on a fixed height naturally varies the effective ratio by container width, matching legacy. Defaults to `380` (the legacy `medium` desktop token) when the caller doesn't resolve one. For the `overlay` layout this is the section's minimum height.

props.name: imageSide
props.doc: Which column the image sits in (for the `split` layout). Defaults to `start`.

props.name: layout
props.doc: The image/text presentation. Defaults to `split`.

props.name: maxWidthPx
props.doc: The section's inner max content width, in px. Unset = full width (token behavior).

props.name: overlayColor
props.doc: Overlay tint color for the `overlay` layout (resolved CSS color). Defaults to black.

props.name: overlayOpacity
props.doc: Overlay opacity percentage (0–100) for the `overlay` layout. Defaults to 50.

props.name: sectionSpacing
props.doc: Vertical-only section padding preset (legacy `section_spacing`). Defaults to `medium` (legacy's own default). Horizontal padding stays the component's own fixed gutter — mirrors legacy's `py-*`-only spacing class (horizontal padding is a separate, non-`sectionSpacing` concern in the oracle).

props.name: text
props.doc: The body markup. Like `ImageWithTextProps.heading`, MUST be pre-sanitized by the caller — it renders via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` (legacy parity: the body is a rich-text field, so bold/italic survives). The caller (`NexusImageWithTextAdapter`) routes it through the same C-1 `sanitizeMerchantHtml` allowlist as `heading`.

props.name: textColor
props.doc: Per-section body-text color override (resolved CSS color).

props.name: textSize
props.doc: Body size preset (legacy `text_size`). Defaults to `m` (16px base / 18px desktop), mirroring `ImageWithTextProps.titleSize`.

props.name: titleSize
props.doc: Heading size preset (legacy `title_size`). Defaults to `m` — legacy's own default, so a fresh, unconfigured insert renders at legacy's real responsive scale (24px base / 30px ≥48rem-container, see `TITLE_SIZE_REM`/`TITLE_SIZE_DESKTOP_REM`), never the browser's plain `<h2>` size.

components.name: Input
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled text field. Renders a native `<input>` (accessible + keyboard-operable by default), associated to its `label` by id. The value is controlled — `value` in, `onChange(next)` out — and all state edges (`error`/`success`/`disabled`/`readOnly`) are pure functions of props.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called with the next raw string on every keystroke. Behavior is fully delegated.

props.name: value
props.doc: Controlled value — the caller owns the text; this component holds no state.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: When `true`, the native `disabled` attr removes it from the tab order and blocks input.

props.name: helper
props.doc: Small helper/error text under the field; recolored to the error register when `state="error"`. Wired to the field via `aria-describedby` (and announced as `role="alert"` in the error state) so assistive tech reads the *message*, not just the generic invalid flag — provided the field has an `id` (from `label` or `id`); without one, the caller owns the association.

props.name: id
props.doc: Explicit element id. Falls back to a slug of `label` so the `<label htmlFor>` stays wired.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label, associated to the control by `id`/`htmlFor`. Strongly recommended for an accessible name; when omitted, supply `id` + an external `<label>` or an `aria-label` via the caller.

props.name: leftIcon
props.doc: Optional leading glyph (e.g. an `<Icon>`), rendered inside the field on the left.

props.name: readOnly
props.doc: When `true`, the field shows its value but is not editable (native `readOnly`).

props.name: state
props.doc: Validation register. Defaults to `default`.

props.name: type
props.doc: Native input type (`text`, `email`, `password`, …). Defaults to `text`.

components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled page header. Pure function of props; the `action` slot is whatever the caller renders (a button, a link, a menu). Server-safe.

props.name: title
props.doc: The area title — rendered as the page `<h1>`.

props.name: action
props.doc: Optional right-aligned action slot (a rendered node — keeps this shell server-safe).

props.name: description
props.doc: Optional secondary description under the title.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled paginator. Renders a `<nav>` with a prev control, the windowed page slots, and a next control. Numbered slots are `<a>` when `hrefForPage` is given, `<button>` when `onPageChange` is given (a page may supply both — href for progressive enhancement, onClick for the SPA path), and inert `<span>`s otherwise. Renders `null` for a single page.

props.name: page
props.doc: The active page (1-based). Clamped into `[1, pageCount]` for display.

props.name: pageCount
props.doc: Total number of pages (>= 1). When `<= 1` the component renders nothing.

props.name: hrefForPage
props.doc: Server-navigable slot — maps a page to an href. Its presence renders numbered `<a>`s.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible label for the nav landmark — localized by the caller (default `Paginación`).

props.name: onPageChange
props.doc: Interactive slot — invoked with the target page. Its presence renders numbered `<button>`s.

props.name: siblingWindow
props.doc: How many numbered slots to show around the current page. Defaults to `7`.

components.name: RichText
components.summary: A stateless rich-text block. Renders `children` when present (already-safe React nodes); otherwise the (caller-sanitized) `html` string via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. Honors the four legacy design settings and the `quote` layout, all driven from nexus tokens.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.doc: Section background. `'auto'`/absent leaves the section transparent (theme background shows through); any other value is applied verbatim as a CSS color (the caller already resolved it).

props.name: children
props.doc: Optional already-safe React children, preferred over `html` when provided.

props.name: contentWidth
props.doc: Content-column max width preset. Defaults to `medium`.

props.name: html
props.doc: The rich-text markup. MUST be pre-sanitized by the caller before reaching this prop — it renders via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` so merchant-authored formatting (headings, bold/italic, links) survives instead of being flattened to plain text.

props.name: layout
props.doc: Presentation layout — `default` (full-width text) or `quote` (accent blockquote).

props.name: quoteAccentColor
props.doc: Quote-layout left-border accent. `'accent'`/absent falls back to the `--color-accent` token; any other value is applied verbatim as a CSS color. Ignored outside the `quote` layout.

props.name: sectionSpacing
props.doc: Vertical section padding preset. Defaults to `medium`.

props.name: textColor
props.doc: Body text color. `'auto'`/absent falls back to the `--color-fg` token; any other value is applied verbatim as a CSS color.

components.name: RowActionsMenu
components.summary: A stateless-per-render kebab menu. Owns only its own open/closed toggle + focus management; every action is delegated to the caller's `onSelect`. Domain-ignorant: it never sees a tenant or capability.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible label for the kebab trigger — localized by the caller (default `Acciones`).

components.name: SectionStack
components.summary: The IR-driven paginated Section Stack carousel. Pure of domain — same `items` render the same view; the only state is UI-local (which slide is active + whether the viewer took manual control), which is legitimate view state, not domain/effect state (RFC-017).

props.name: items
props.doc: The slides, in the order the IR declares them. Empty → the component renders nothing.

props.name: autoPlayMs
props.doc: Auto-rotate interval in ms (canon §3: 8–10s, slower than tabs). `0`/omitted disables auto-play — the component is then a pure manual carousel (deterministic for golden tests).

components.name: Select
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled native `<select>`. Associated to its `label` by id, keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible by default. The value is controlled — `value` in, `onChange(next)` out.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called with the next option value on change. Behavior is fully delegated.

props.name: options
props.doc: The options to render, as typed `{ value, label }` pairs (no bare-string shorthand — explicit).

props.name: value
props.doc: Controlled selected value — the caller owns it; this component holds no state.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: When `true`, the native `disabled` attr removes it from the tab order and blocks selection.

props.name: id
props.doc: Explicit element id. Falls back to a slug of `label` so the `<label htmlFor>` stays wired.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label, associated to the control by `id`/`htmlFor`. Strongly recommended for an accessible name; when omitted, supply `id` + an external `<label>` or an `aria-label` via the caller.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Placeholder rendered as a disabled empty-value option (shown when `value === ''`).

components.name: SurfaceCard
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled dashboard card. Renders a bordered white surface; when `title` is set it renders a `<header>` with a real heading (level `headingLevel`) plus the optional `headerAction`, then the `children` body, then the optional right-aligned `footer`. All styling flows from the DASHBOARD brand tokens; all behavior is delegated to the nodes the caller passes.

props.name: children
props.doc: The card body.

props.name: elevated
props.doc: Apply the dashboard system card shadow (`--shadow-dash-card`). Defaults to `true`.

props.name: footer
props.doc: Optional footer slot for actions — laid out as a right-aligned row (a rendered node).

props.name: headerAction
props.doc: Optional trailing header slot, aligned to the right of the title (e.g. an edit link or menu).

props.name: headingLevel
props.doc: Heading level for `title`. Defaults to `3`.

props.name: padding
props.doc: Inner padding. Defaults to `lg` (24px).

props.name: size
props.doc: Corner radius. Defaults to `md` (10px).

props.name: title
props.doc: Optional header title. When present, rendered as a heading (`headingLevel`, default `h3`).

components.name: Switch
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled switch. Renders a native `<button role="switch" aria-checked>` (focusable, Enter/Space-operable for free) beside an optional label. The state is controlled — `checked` in, `onCheckedChange(next)` out. Provide `label` (string) or `ariaLabel` for the accessible name.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Controlled on/off state — the caller owns it; this component holds no state.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.doc: Called with the next boolean on activation (click or Enter/Space). Behavior is delegated.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Explicit accessible name for the switch, overriding the string `label`. Required when neither is a string.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: When `true`, the native `disabled` attr removes it from the tab order and blocks toggling.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label text beside the toggle. Also drives the accessible name via `aria-label`.

components.name: T1FinalCTA
components.summary: `<T1FinalCTA>` — renders the human-avatars final CTA from its IR slice. Stateless and total: an empty `avatars` array renders the enterprise/counter-style close (canon `LANDING-SECTIONS.md:1316`) without the row; a missing `description` simply omits the line. Routing is delegated via `onAction`.

props.name: onAction
props.doc: Invoked with the activated CTA so the host owns navigation (the section never embeds a route literal).

components.name: T1LifestyleCards
components.summary: The lifestyle section — variant *3 human-photo profiles*. Renders exactly `slice.cards` in their IR-declared order; an empty `cards` array renders the heading with no grid (a total function — the section never invents a card the slice did not declare).

props.name: slice
props.doc: The projected IR slice. All rendered content comes from here.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled tab bar implementing the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern. Selection is controlled — `activeId` in, `onSelect(nextId)` out. Click, Arrow-Left/Right, and Home/End all move selection via the callback; when tabs carry `content`, the active panel renders below, labelled by its header.

props.name: activeId
props.doc: Controlled active tab id — the caller owns it; this component holds no state.

props.name: onSelect
props.doc: Called with the next tab id on click or keyboard navigation. Behavior is fully delegated.

props.name: tabs
props.doc: The tabs to render, in order.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled chip. Renders a `<span>`; when `onRemove` is provided it appends an accessible remove `<button>` (`aria-label={removeLabel}`). All behavior is delegated via props.

props.name: onRemove
props.doc: When provided, renders an accessible remove (`×`) control and calls this on activation.

props.name: removeLabel
props.doc: Accessible label for the remove control — localized by the caller (default `Quitar`).

props.name: selected
props.doc: Selected chips use the brand-red register; the default is neutral gray.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: A stateless, token-styled multi-line text field. Renders a native `<textarea>` (accessible + keyboard-operable by default), associated to its `label` by id. The value is controlled — `value` in, `onChange(next)` out — and all state edges (`error`/`success`/`disabled`/`readOnly`) are pure functions of props.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called with the next raw string on every keystroke. Behavior is fully delegated.

props.name: value
props.doc: Controlled value — the caller owns the text; this component holds no state.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: When `true`, the native `disabled` attr removes it from the tab order and blocks input.

props.name: helper
props.doc: Small helper/error text under the field; recolored to the error register when `state="error"`. Wired to the field via `aria-describedby` (and announced as `role="alert"` in the error state) so assistive tech reads the *message*, not just the generic invalid flag — provided the field has an `id` (from `label` or `id`); without one, the caller owns the association.

props.name: id
props.doc: Explicit element id. Falls back to a slug of `label` so the `<label htmlFor>` stays wired.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label, associated to the control by `id`/`htmlFor`. Strongly recommended for an accessible name; when omitted, supply `id` + an external `<label>` or an `aria-label` via the caller.

props.name: readOnly
props.doc: When `true`, the field shows its value but is not editable (native `readOnly`).

props.name: rows
props.doc: Visible row count (native `rows`). Defaults to `4`.

props.name: state
props.doc: Validation register. Defaults to `default`.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A single toast. Stateless w.r.t. its queue position (the `ToastProvider` owns the stack); it owns only its own enter transition + auto-dismiss timer. Renders `<Alert>` as the live region and, when `action` is present, a Nexus `<Button>` beneath the message.

props.name: message
props.doc: The toast body — user-facing copy (localized by the caller).

props.name: action
props.doc: Optional call-to-action; its presence pins the toast open (no auto-dismiss).

props.name: dismissLabel
props.doc: Accessible label for the dismiss control — localized by the caller (default `Cerrar`).

props.name: durationMs
props.doc: Auto-dismiss override in ms. `undefined` ⇒ the severity/action default; a positive number ⇒ that timeout; `null`/`0`/negative ⇒ persist. See `resolveToastDurationMs`.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Optional leading icon element, tinted to the variant's border color (forwarded to `<Alert>`).

props.name: onDismiss
props.doc: Dismiss handler — wires the `×` control, `Escape`, and auto-dismiss.

props.name: severity
props.doc: The semantic severity. Defaults to `info`.

props.name: title
props.doc: Optional bold title above the message (forwarded to `<Alert>`).

components.name: ToastProvider
components.summary: Provide the toast API to a subtree and render the portaled viewport. State (the live stack) lives here; individual `Toast`s own their own timer + transition.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible label for the toast viewport region — localized by the caller (default `Notificaciones`).

props.name: maxVisible
props.doc: Max toasts visible at once; excess is dropped FIFO (oldest first). Defaults to 3.

PageSlot.declaration: export type PageSlot = number | typeof PAGE_ELLIPSIS;

EnqueueToast.declaration: type EnqueueToast = (message: ReactNode, options?: ToastOptions) => string;
